title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for the frequency of the reflected wave must be correctly stated as omega_2 = ((1 - beta)/(1 + beta)) * omega.

title: Use of Lorentz Transformation
description: Important Criteria: The application of the Lorentz transformation for the frequency and wave vector must be correctly shown.

title: Definition of Variables
description: Important Criteria: The definitions of beta and gamma must be clearly stated and used appropriately in the solution.

title: Reflection Frequency Condition
description: Important Criteria: The condition that no change in frequency occurs upon reflection in the moving medium must be correctly applied.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The units of frequency and wave vector should be consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect application of the Lorentz transformation should be penalized.

title: Mathematical Derivation
description: Optional Criteria: The steps in the mathematical derivation should be clearly laid out and logically follow from one another.
